newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bill yield seen at mkt level at Wed sale.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bill yield seen at mkt level at Wed sale.

text.p: Foreign investors interested in Russian paper yields, which have risen recently in secondary trade, are likely to bid strongly for GKO discount Treasury bills at Wednesday's sale, leaving the price close to current secondary market levels, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said the average price for an OFZ interest-bearing bond, which is not in demand by foreigners who are increasingly the strongest participants in the market, would be below market level.
*10.00 trln rbls in 728-day OFZ interest-bearing bond (series 24015)
*361.70 bln rbls in coupon payment on series 24008 OFZ bond and up to 4.81 trln rbls in voluntary repayment
*7.48 trln rbls in maturing six-month T-bills (series 22069)
*Average yield rose to 18.9 pct from 18.4 pct on Monday
*Turnover rose to 5.32 trln rbls from 2.06 trln rbls
*Central bank bought 300 trln rbls of T-bills

Dealers forecast the average yield at the T-bill auction would be 19.07-19.84 percent. The series 21078 bills, maturing on July 7, 1998, the closest maturity date to the new issue, on Tuesday closed at 84.35 to yield 19.19.

Dealers forecast the average price for the OFZ bond at auction would be 96.14-100.50 percent. The series 24014 bond, maturing June 16, 1999, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 98.52 to yield 23.22 percent.
